name: MusicBrainz Album Subset
description: Subset of the MusicBrainz dataset covering more than 4,000 different albums (releases). Releases are described by attributes such as title, artist, release date, release country, and the list of tracks contained on the album. Some attribute values are missing or incorrect. The dataset is provided as XML and uses the MusicBrainz MMD 2.0 namespace.

variableMeasured.name: Attribute_1
variableMeasured.description: MusicBrainz-derived record identifier for the music release

variableMeasured.name: Attribute_3
variableMeasured.description: Artist or group credited for the release

variableMeasured.name: Attribute_4
variableMeasured.description: Release date normalized to YYYY-MM-DD where available

variableMeasured.name: Attribute_5
variableMeasured.description: Country where the release was published

variableMeasured.name: Attribute_6
variableMeasured.description: Total duration of the release in seconds

variableMeasured.name: Attribute_9
variableMeasured.description: List of track titles on the release
